summary: Caesarstone Ltd. furnished a Form -6-K attaching its third-quarter 2026 earnings release (quarter ended September 30, 2026), a routine periodic results announcement rather than a special-situation event. Revenue was $96.3 million with gross margin of 25.4%; the quarter produced a net loss of $56.1 million, including $46.8 million tied to a California jury verdict, and an adjusted net loss of $1.6 million near breakeven adjusted EBITDA. Management reiterated its disagreement with the verdict and is weighing post-trial remedies. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics are disclosed; watch litigation and remediation risk.
